e.title_en: Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving: paper companion code that documents where its deposited summaries came from
e.title_hk: 隨機森林 ＋ pipeline 校準用於 RBNS 與 IBNR 準備金：論文配套代碼，並交代「已存摘要」的來源
e.summary: 一篇 2026 年提交论文的配套代码：把随机森林与「pipeline 校准」用于 RBNS 与 IBNR 准备金估计，作者为查理大学概率与数理统计系的 Jan Janoušek 与 Michal Pešta；仓库含实验矩阵、示例数据集，并单设一节交代所存摘要的来源
e.summary_hk: 一篇 2026 年提交論文的配套代碼：把隨機森林與「pipeline 校準」用於 RBNS 與 IBNR 準備金估計，作者為查理大學概率與數理統計系的 Jan Janoušek 與 Michal Pešta；倉庫含實驗矩陣、示例數據集，並單設一節交代所存摘要的來源
e.summary_en: Companion code for a paper submitted in 2026: it applies random forests with pipeline calibration to RBNS and IBNR reserve estimation, by Jan Janoušek and Michal Pešta of the Department of Probability and Mathematical Statistics at Charles University; the repository carries an experiment matrix, an illustrative dataset, and a dedicated section documenting the provenance of its deposited summaries
e.body:
**rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving** 是一篇**学术论文的配套代码**（仓库 `HeirOfIsildur/rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 3,041 KB、创建于 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**该仓库实测无 topics**。本条目属于本轮主题**「准备金与保险市场数据」**中的**第一种路径：学术方法**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：**仓库描述逐字**：**「Code and deposited summaries for ‘**Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving**’ (**Janousek & Pesta, 2026**)」**。**README 实测 11,595 字节**，**其首段逐字**：**「Companion code for the paper *Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving* by Jan Janoušek and Michal Pešta (**Charles University, Department of Probability and Mathematical Statistics**; submitted, 2026).」**——**即：该仓库是论文《用于 RBNS 与 IBNR 准备金的随机森林与 pipeline 校准》的配套代码，作者为**查理大学概率与数理统计系**的 Jan Janoušek 与 Michal Pešta，**论文已于 2026 年提交****。**章节结构逐字实测**：**What this version adds (release v1.0, 2026)／⭐ What the method does／Code layout／⭐⭐ Experiment matrix／⭐⭐⭐ Provenance of the deposited summaries／⭐ Deposited files／Data／⭐ Illustrative dataset／Install／Run／License**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Provenance of the deposited summaries（所存摘要的来源）」单设一节，是本条目最值得注意的一点，也是它与其他论文配套仓库的实质差别**——**学术代码常见的问题是：论文里的数字、图与表从哪里来，读者无从核对****；**把「这些已存摘要怎么产生的」单列一节说明，等于**把结果的可追溯性写进仓库结构****；**这与本词条所在站点反复出现的纪律（[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 的可复现、[[verified-reserving]] 的可验证、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]] 的基准）同源，**且做得更具体：**不是宣称「结果可复现」，而是**交代这批具体产物的来历****（**⚠️ 本次未读该节正文，故不转述其交代了哪些内容**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「RBNS 与 IBNR」并列为研究对象，值得单独记一笔**——**IBNR（已发生未报案）是准备金估计里最常被讨论的一类，而 **RBNS（已报案未结案）**处理的是**已报案但尚未结清的赔案****；**两者都属准备金负债，但数据形态与不确定性来源不同**；**对做非寿险准备金的学生，把两者**分开处理**而非合并，是一个方法上的自觉**（**可与池内 [[ibnr]]、[[chainladder]]、[[chainladder-python]]、[[lossdevt]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 并读**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「Experiment matrix（实验矩阵）」单设一节**——**它把**做了哪些实验、各自变量是什么**以矩阵形式列出**，**而不是散落在结果里**；**对做模型比较的学生，这是一个好的组织方式**（**可与池内 [[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-robust]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[reserving-neural]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]] 并读**；**⚠️ 本次未读该节，故不转述其具体实验设计**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「Illustrative dataset（示例数据集）」单设一节**——**准备金方法论文的可复现性高度依赖**用什么数据**；**单列一节说明示例数据，使读者能重跑**（**⚠️ 本次未读其内容与数据来源**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「pipeline calibration（流水线校准）」是本方法的核心提法**——**「校准」在准备金语境下通常指**让模型的输出与实际观测相符**；**而把它放进**流水线**意味着**校准是流程中的一个环节**，而非事后调整**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其具体含义或实现**——**「pipeline calibration」未在本次读到的部分被定义，故不转述**）。**⑥ ⭐ 作者与机构具名，且论文状态写明为 submitted（已提交）**——**即**未经同行评审完成**这一状态被如实写出**；**对读者而言，「已提交」与「已发表」的区别重要**（**本词条据此**不主张**其方法已获同行认可**）。**⑦ ⭐ MIT 许可是本会话同类学术配套代码中较清晰的**（**可与 [[actuarialdatascience]]、[[lossmodels]]、[[ratingmodels]]、[[projectionmodels]] 所代表的 R 生态并读**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库描述全文、README（11,595 字节）的首段与完整章节结构**，⭐ **但**未读 README 多数章节正文（含 What the method does、Experiment matrix、Provenance of the deposited summaries、Deposited files 等）、未克隆、未安装、未运行任何实验、未打开其示例数据集或已存摘要****，因此**不能转述其方法细节、随机森林超参数、校准的具体做法、实验设计、任何数值结果，或已存摘要的实际内容与来历**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「Provenance of the deposited summaries」一节**只读到标题**——**本词条**不主张**其确实完整交代了摘要的来源**；**这一点正是本条最值得后续核实之处**；**③ ⭐⭐ **未核实**该论文是否真的存在、是否真的已提交、以及提交到何处**——**本次未查 arXiv、SSRN 或任何期刊**；**「submitted, 2026」为**其自述**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实**两位作者的姓名、机构与身份**（**均来自 README 自述**）；**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **「pipeline calibration」这一核心术语的含义本次未读到定义****——**本词条**不主张**其在本文中的具体所指，也不主张其为任何既有标准方法**；**⑥ ⭐ **未核实**其方法在经典方法（Chain Ladder／BF／Cape Cod／Benktander 等）之上是否确有改进**——**论文结论本次未读，**故不作任何性能主张**；**⑦ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同日（2026-09-10）**，**说明其极新且关注度极低**，**不主张其方法质量、结论可靠性或已被引用**；**⑧ ⭐ 本词条**不主张**其代码可用于任何真实准备金评估**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/HeirOfIsildur/rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 11,595 字节，首段与章节结构逐字核对）；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读多数章节正文、未查论文**。
e.body_hk:
**rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving** 是一篇**學術論文的配套代碼**（倉庫 `HeirOfIsildur/rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving`），**MIT 許可，實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 3,041 KB、創建於 2026-09-10、最後推送 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**該倉庫實測無 topics**。本條目屬本輪主題**「準備金與保險市場數據」**中的**第一種路徑：學術方法**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字**：**「Code and deposited summaries for ‘**Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving**’ (**Janousek & Pesta, 2026**)」**。**README 實測 11,595 位元組**，**首段逐字**：**「Companion code for the paper *Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving* by Jan Janoušek and Michal Pešta (**Charles University, Department of Probability and Mathematical Statistics**; submitted, 2026).」**。**章節結構逐字實測**：**What this version adds (release v1.0, 2026)／⭐What the method does／Code layout／⭐⭐Experiment matrix／⭐⭐⭐Provenance of the deposited summaries／⭐Deposited files／Data／⭐Illustrative dataset／Install／Run／License**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Provenance of the deposited summaries」單設一節，是本條目最值得注意的一點**——**學術代碼常見的問題是：論文裡的數字、圖與表從哪裡來，讀者無從核對****；**把「這些已存摘要怎麼產生的」單列一節，等於**把結果的可追溯性寫進倉庫結構****（可與 [[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[claims-reserving-benchmark]] 並讀——**不是宣稱「結果可複現」，而是**交代這批具體產物的來歷****；**⚠️ 未讀該節正文，故不轉述其交代了哪些內容**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「RBNS 與 IBNR」並列為研究對象值得單獨記**——**IBNR（已發生未報案）最常被討論，而 **RBNS（已報案未結案）**處理的是已報案但尚未結清的賠案****；**兩者都屬準備金負債，但數據形態與不確定性來源不同**（可與 [[ibnr]]、[[chainladder]]、[[chainladder-python]]、[[lossdevt]]、[[stochastic-reserving-england]] 並讀）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「Experiment matrix」單設一節**——**把做了哪些實驗、各自變量是什麼以矩陣列出，而非散落在結果裡**（可與 [[reserving-ensemble]]、[[reserving-robust]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[reserving-neural]] 並讀）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「Illustrative dataset」單設一節**——**準備金方法論文的可複現性高度依賴用什麼數據****（**⚠️ 未讀其內容與數據來源**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「pipeline calibration」是本方法的核心提法**——**「校準」在準備金語境下通常指讓模型輸出與實際觀測相符；放進**流水線**意味著校準是流程中的一環而非事後調整**（**⚠️ 本次未讀到其定義，故不轉述其具體所指**）。**⑥ ⭐ 作者與機構具名，且論文狀態寫明為 submitted**——**即**未經同行評審完成**這一狀態被如實寫出**；**不主張**其方法已獲同行認可**。**⑦ ⭐ MIT 許可在同類學術配套代碼中較清晰**（可與 [[actuarialdatascience]]、[[lossmodels]]、[[ratingmodels]]、[[projectionmodels]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、描述全文、README 首段與完整章節結構**，⭐ **但**未讀多數章節正文、未克隆、未安裝、未運行任何實驗、未打開其示例數據集或已存摘要****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「Provenance of the deposited summaries」一節**只讀到標題****——**不主張**其確實完整交代了摘要的來源**；**這一點正是本條最值得後續核實之處**；**③ ⭐⭐ **未核實**該論文是否真的存在、是否真的已提交、提交到何處**——**未查 arXiv、SSRN 或任何期刊**；**「submitted, 2026」為其自述**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核實**兩位作者的姓名、機構與身份**；**⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ **「pipeline calibration」的含義本次未讀到定義****——**不主張**其在本文中的具體所指，也不主張其為任何既有標準方法**；**⑥ ⭐ **未核實**其方法相對經典方法是否確有改進**——**論文結論未讀，故不作任何性能主張**；**⑦ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、創建與推送同日**，**不主張其方法質量、結論可靠性或已被引用**；**⑧ ⭐ **不主張**其代碼可用於任何真實準備金評估**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/HeirOfIsildur/rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未克隆、未安裝、未運行、未讀多數章節正文、未查論文**。
e.body_en:
**rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving** is **companion code for an academic paper** (repository `HeirOfIsildur/rf-pipeline-calibration-reserving`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 3,041 KB repository, created 2026-09-10 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **the repository measurably has no topics**. It is the first of this round’s paths to making reserving and insurance-market data legible: **an academic method**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"Code and deposited summaries for ‘Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving’ (Janousek & Pesta, 2026)."** **The README measures 11,595 bytes**, its **opening reading verbatim**: **"Companion code for the paper *Random forests with pipeline calibration for RBNS and IBNR reserving* by Jan Janoušek and Michal Pešta (Charles University, Department of Probability and Mathematical Statistics; submitted, 2026)."** **Section headings read verbatim**: **What this version adds (release v1.0, 2026) / ⭐ What the method does / Code layout / ⭐⭐ Experiment matrix / ⭐⭐⭐ Provenance of the deposited summaries / ⭐ Deposited files / Data / ⭐ Illustrative dataset / Install / Run / License**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A dedicated section on the "Provenance of the deposited summaries" is the entry’s most notable point and its substantive difference from other paper-companion repositories** — **the common failure of academic code is that a reader cannot check where the numbers, figures and tables in the paper came from**; **giving their generation its own section writes traceability of results into the repository structure**; **the same discipline as [[reproducible-actuarial-work]], [[verified-reserving]] and [[claims-reserving-benchmark]], but more concrete: not a claim that "results are reproducible" but an account of where this particular set of artefacts came from** (**⚠️ that section body was not read, so what it actually documents is not restated**). **② ⭐⭐ Treating RBNS and IBNR as parallel objects deserves separate note** — **IBNR (incurred but not reported) is the most discussed class in reserving, while RBNS (reported but not settled) covers claims already reported but not yet closed**; **both are reserve liabilities but differ in data form and sources of uncertainty**; **handling them separately rather than merging them is a methodological self-awareness for students of non-life reserving** (**readable with [[ibnr]], [[chainladder]], [[chainladder-python]], [[lossdevt]] and [[stochastic-reserving-england]]**). **③ ⭐⭐ A dedicated "Experiment matrix" section** — **it lays out which experiments were run and what the variables were in matrix form rather than scattering them through the results**; **a good organisation for students doing model comparison** (**readable with [[reserving-ensemble]], [[reserving-robust]], [[reserving-ml]] and [[reserving-neural]]**; **⚠️ that section was not read, so its experiment design is not restated**). **④ ⭐⭐ A dedicated "Illustrative dataset" section** — **the reproducibility of a reserving paper depends heavily on which data it uses**; **giving the example data its own section lets readers rerun it** (**⚠️ its content and provenance were not read**). **⑤ ⭐ "Pipeline calibration" is the method’s core phrase** — **calibration in a reserving context usually means making a model’s output agree with observation, and putting it in a pipeline makes calibration a stage in the process rather than an after-the-fact adjustment** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim its specific meaning: the phrase was not defined in the portion read, so it is not restated**). **⑥ ⭐ The authors and institution are named, and the paper’s status is written as submitted** — **i.e. the not-yet-peer-reviewed status is stated plainly**; **the entry accordingly does not claim the method has received peer acceptance**. **⑦ ⭐ MIT licensing is comparatively clear among academic companion code in this session** (**readable with the R ecosystem entries [[actuarialdatascience]], [[lossmodels]], [[ratingmodels]] and [[projectionmodels]]**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata, the full repository description, and the README’s 11,595 bytes in respect of its opening and complete section structure**, ⭐ **but did not read most section bodies (including What the method does, Experiment matrix, Provenance of the deposited summaries, Deposited files), clone, install, run any experiment, or open its illustrative dataset or deposited summaries**, so **its method detail, random-forest hyperparameters, the calibration procedure, the experiment design, any numerical result, and the deposited summaries’ content and provenance cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ The "Provenance of the deposited summaries" section was read only as a heading** — **the entry does not claim it really documents the summaries’ origins in full**; **this is precisely the point most worth verifying later**; **③ ⭐⭐ Whether the paper actually exists, whether it has really been submitted, and where, were not verified** — **neither arXiv, SSRN nor any journal was checked**; **"submitted, 2026" is its own statement**; **④ ⭐⭐ The two authors’ names, institution and identity were not verified** (**all come from the README’s own text**); **⑤ ⭐ ⚠️ The meaning of the core term "pipeline calibration" was not found defined** — **the entry does not claim what it means in this paper, nor that it is any established standard method**; **⑥ ⭐ Whether the method improves on classical approaches (Chain Ladder, BF, Cape Cod, Benktander and so on) was not verified** — **the paper’s conclusions were not read, so no performance claim is made**; **⑦ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed on the same day, 2026-09-10**, **no methodological quality, reliability of conclusions or citation record is claimed**; **⑧ ⭐ The entry does not claim its code is usable for any real reserve assessment**;
